established: a zero-fit B6-informed reduced shell solver with target-value-free residual stopping
the complete A1/T1/E ordering at every frozen and fresh off-grid point
machine-precision agreement at the tested points and full-space Ritz residual certification
a reduced A1/T1 crossing prediction independent of target eigenvalues
claim_boundary.narrow_novelty: The potentially publishable point is the theory-specific quotient: the 1+3+2 SU(3) cube shell generated by energy-decorated temporal-history words is represented by a deterministic low-hundreds-dimensional, residual-certified model over the tested interval. Block Krylov and Feshbach reduction themselves are established prior art.
not_established: elimination of B6 basis or local-action generation
accuracy outside the tested one-cube B6 sector or for all g by theorem
novelty of Krylov or Feshbach reduction as a numerical method

global_invariance_check.boundary: Applying E or M to the retained L=8 basis produces additional directions. Machine-precision claims apply to the tracked Ritz branches at tested points and the residual sweep, not to the entire B6 spectrum or automatically every g.

six_seed_schur_consistency.method: factorized six-seed explicit-word SVD: construct a canonical orthonormal basis of each face irrep, apply the same 511-word SVD to every one of the 1+3+2 carrier components, then rank their combined orthonormal bases

convergence.svd_rank_tolerance_basis: The declared 1e-10 relative cutoff is far above double-precision roundoff. The retained ranks are unchanged over the explicitly checked 1e-8 through 1e-14 interval because the cutoff singular gaps exceed 1e8.

crossing.comparison_boundary: The prior full value is a linear interpolation inside a width-0.0025 bracket, whereas the reduced value is a Brent root of the Ritz-converged model.

A1--.rule: project each standard face basis vector; choose the largest norm with lowest-index tie break; normalize; make the first nonzero entry positive

E--.rule: project each standard face basis vector; choose the largest norm with lowest-index tie break; normalize; make the first nonzero entry positive

T1+-.rule: project each standard face basis vector; choose the largest norm with lowest-index tie break; normalize; make the first nonzero entry positive

definition.space: K_L(r)=span{w(E_tilde,M_tilde) F v_r : w is a noncommutative word of length <=L}, for one normalized v_r in each cubical irrep r=A1,T1,E
definition.symmetry_argument: E and M commute with the cubic action.  By Schur's lemma every component of a fixed irrep has the same radial reduced operator, so one representative predicts the full 1+3+2 shell energies.
definition.word_generation: Explicitly generate every centered/scaled E and scaled M word through level L, normalize each nonzero word column (which does not change its span), stack all 2^(L+1)-1 columns, and take one global rank-revealing SVD. Centering, scaling, and column normalization do not change the word space.

dimension_and_storage.dimension_boundary: The quoted dimension is algorithm- and SVD-rank-tolerance-specific. Carrier vectors are fixed canonically; explicit-word SVD ranks, full singular ledgers, and tolerance sensitivity are reported under convergence.

crossing_root_full_solve.reason: At the predicted symmetry-protected crossing, strict ordering is undefined; the full solve differs from zero only at eigensolver roundoff.

target_blindness.model_selection_chronology: Historically, L=8 was identified after inspecting convergence on the original 11-point grid. Those 11 points are therefore retrospective, not out-of-sample or preregistered evidence. This stable replay makes the stopping rule non-circular by using only full-space Ritz residuals. The validation-grid predictions, including two points bracketing the reduced crossing, were sealed before their fresh full B6 solves.
target_blindness.selection_disclosure: The residual rule is auditable and target-value-free but was not externally preregistered. The script opens the target certificate only after the predictions and their canonical hash are sealed.
target_blindness.selection_rule: first word level whose maximum full-space Ritz residual on the already frozen g grid is <=1e-10

timing.boundary: Observed warm local timings are implementation and hardware specific. Construction consumes the saved full B6 E,M; online timing starts after the reduced blocks exist.
